name: Caster with memes

narration.persona: an esports caster calling it live: present tense, shouting at the big moments, hearts and pressure

brief: Esports energy. The very first thing on screen is the last second before the final blow (the leap, the swing), with the caster already mid-shout, cut on the blow itself so the result stays unknown; then rewind and show how it came to that. Fast talk, excited, every line about pressure and hearts. Dramatic finale song. This one may use the meme clips (a WASTED on a death, a FIGHT on the first hit, the Hulk on a rampage, the troll face on a pause): up to three in the film, each on a moment that really is that, never two on one beat.
